basis: Static semantic review only; no external model calls and no behavioral claim.

common_findings.finding: All blueprints list output status values but do not define explicit state transition rules.
common_findings.impact: A runtime could choose a stronger state for rhetorical decisiveness even when evidence or inputs do not justify it.
common_findings.required_change: Add a STATE POLICY section with deterministic semantic conditions for every allowed state; strongest state must never exceed evidence/input state.

common_findings.finding: The input contract presents one combined list as 'required or conditionally required' without distinguishing minimum execution inputs from contextual enhancers.
common_findings.impact: A binder cannot deterministically know when to execute, continue with unknowns, or block.
common_findings.required_change: Split minimum required inputs, conditionally required inputs, and optional context at configuration/binding time.

common_findings.finding: Instruction/data boundary is explicit and consistent across all nine blueprints.
common_findings.impact: Embedded instructions in code, logs, documents, tickets, web content and tool output are explicitly data and cannot change workflow authority or policy.
common_findings.required_change: Preserve as an invariant in all successors.

common_findings.finding: Authority is explicitly bounded to ADVISORY_ONLY by default.
common_findings.impact: Availability of tools or external access does not silently expand execution authority.
common_findings.required_change: Preserve and make authority configurable only through an authorized binding surface.

common_findings.finding: Evidence vocabulary separates supplied claims, observations, source claims, inference, assumptions, unknowns and contradiction.
common_findings.impact: The architecture no longer treats user-supplied statements as automatically observed facts.

common_findings.finding: High-stakes categories are intentionally not encoded into the generic base architecture.
common_findings.impact: This is correct for reuse, but the 69 current high-stakes records must not be regenerated from the generic blueprint without a separate domain safety binding contract.
common_findings.required_change: Keep all high-stakes records in explicit review and design a separate high-stakes binding gate before any domain-specific regeneration.

general.finding: UNSUPPORTED is listed but its distinction from BLOCKED is not defined.
general.required_change: Define BLOCKED as missing/contradictory required input and UNSUPPORTED as a requested conclusion/action outside evidence, scope or authority even when inputs are present.

plan.finding: READY can be misread as evidence that the plan will succeed.
plan.required_change: Define READY as plan-contract completeness only; it must not imply outcome success. Unknown owner, estimate or dependency facts remain explicit.

generation.finding: The output requests a shortlist but does not define behavior when no candidate satisfies hard constraints or candidates are effectively tied.
generation.required_change: Add NO_VALID_CANDIDATE/HOLD semantics or equivalent and forbid forcing a winner.

writing.finding: The output always asks for a final draft even when unresolved factual information is required to write responsibly.
writing.required_change: When a missing fact is material to the requested claim, return BLOCKED or preserve explicit placeholders; never silently complete the claim.

audit.finding: COMPLETE could be mistaken for a certification/pass result.
audit.required_change: Define COMPLETE as completion of the declared audit procedure only; overall disposition must not imply external certification or uninspected scope.

simulation.finding: The architecture mixes interactive multi-turn execution with a one-shot output contract without declaring invocation mode.
simulation.required_change: Add INTERACTIVE vs BATCH/DEBRIEF invocation semantics. IN_PROGRESS is valid only for interactive execution; simulated facts remain non-evidence.

learning.finding: OBJECTIVE_MET can be selected without an explicit evidence threshold.
learning.required_change: Require observable assessment evidence tied to the learning objective before OBJECTIVE_MET; self-declared understanding alone is insufficient unless that is the configured criterion.

optimization.finding: READY and DIAGNOSE_FIRST need an explicit baseline threshold.
optimization.required_change: Use DIAGNOSE_FIRST when the baseline/metric evidence is insufficient to identify a defensible bottleneck or measure improvement.

checklist.finding: PASS is not tied to an explicit item-level completion rule.
checklist.required_change: PASS requires every applicable required item to satisfy the declared pass condition and no blocking UNKNOWN/RISK; missing evidence never becomes PASS.

next_gate: Revise the nine architecture blueprints to close all HIGH findings, re-run deterministic tests, then perform a second static semantic audit before bulk regeneration.
